headline: H100 SXM and H200 rental prices climb sharply over 7 days while MI300X leads on price-performance.
bullets: H100 SXM posted the biggest 7-day move at +23%, lifting its market index to $5.33 with a +147% hyperscaler premium, the widest of any GPU.
H200 rose +17% over 7 days to a $6.31 market index, with hyperscalers at $10.30 versus $5.40 at neoclouds.
B200 gained +5% to an $8.44 index, and RunPod Community Cloud offers the lowest median at $5.98 against a $14.12 hyperscaler median.
MI300X was flat at +0% and delivers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, with a $3.45 index across only 5 providers.
A100 80GB SXM and L40S held steady at +0%, with market indexes of $2.70 and $1.50 respectively.
watch: Whether the +23% H100 SXM and +17% H200 run-ups spill over into B200 pricing, which so far has moved only +5%.
